tasks.title: Fusing two measurements
tasks.solution: Weight by inverse variances: x̂ = (x₁/σ₁² + x₂/σ₂²)/(1/σ₁² + 1/σ₂²). The more accurate sensor pulls the estimate toward itself.

tasks.title: Accuracy after fusion
tasks.solution: 1/σ² = 1/σ₁² + 1/σ₂². The combined estimate is always more accurate than the best of the sensors.

tasks.title: Kalman gain
tasks.solution: K = P/(P + R). With a noisy measurement (R ≫ P) the filter barely listens to the sensor; with a confident measurement K → 1.
